app.name: MiiFlood
app.short_description: Bulk-import Miis into the Mii Parade
app.long_description:
Merges Miis from SD/USB (.mii files, .miis bundles, or other consoles' RFL_DB.dat) into the Mii Parade (up to 10,000), keeps an unlimited archive on the card, and backs up RFL_DB.dat before every change.
Folder: apps/MiiFlood/import
